title: AfroXLMR-Social: Adapting Pre-trained Language Models for African Languages Social Media Text
reasoning: The paper focuses on domain adaptation for African languages on social media, evaluating performance on sentiment analysis, emotion classification, and hate speech detection. While it notes that low-resource language data is often 'biased to a religious domain' (referring to source material like the Bible), it does not benchmark or evaluate religious beliefs, morals, or ethics.
